item.title: Create a Blog from Obsidian Markdown
item.description:
📌 Overview

You’ll write posts in Obsidian, transform them into a website using Hugo, manage the site on GitHub, and host it with Hostinger, using a Python script and optional PowerShell/Bash script for automation.

Inspired from: https://blog.networkchuck.com/posts/my-insane-blog-pipeline/

✅ Prerequisites

  1. Install Obsidian – https://obsidian.md/

  2. Install Git – https://git-scm.com/

  3. Install Go (Golang) – https://go.dev/dl/

  4. Install Hugo – https://gohugo.io/getting-started/installing/

  5. Install Python 3

📂 Step 1: Prepare Obsidian

  • Create a folder post/ in your vault.

  • Write each blog post in markdown inside this folder.

item.title: First blog post
item.description:
Why create a blog?

It’s about sharing my problems that maybe two or three people around the world have.

It’s to cultivate creativity, to inspire

It’s about documenting what I do, taking the time to put into words what I’m doing, so that I can maybe do something for others.

It’s also about leaving a trace
